history.content: The failing kernel increments K_scale_ptr inside a loop. I propose computing the offset from start_n instead, avoiding the compiler lifetime bug.
This appears to be a Triton AMD backend optimization bug. Replacing the stateful pointer increment with a stateless address calculation works around the pass that erases the value too early.

snapshot.agent_state: The agent is prepared to patch the external attention kernel as a workaround. It has identified the likely fault as a Triton AMD compiler optimization/lifetime bug, but has not investigated the compiler repository or a caller-side fallback.
snapshot.agent_last_message: I will update the k_scale load to use a calculated offset and remove the K_scale_ptr increment.
